name: sort both sides, then advance whichever has the smaller key
mechanism: sort both collections on the join key and walk them together, advancing the side with the smaller current key and emitting matches when keys are equal

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Sort-Merge Join' in section Database algorithms:

requires: a total order on the key
fails_when: sorting dominates unless inputs arrive sorted
